example: The change in the law makes the previous agreement null and void.
法律變更致使之前的協議失去了約束力。
The election was declared null and void.

NONE: › formal to make a legal agreement or decision have no legal force
使（協議或決議）失去法律效力
› to cause something to have no value or effect

example: All my hard work was nullified when I lost my notes.
由於遺失了筆記，我所有的辛苦心血都化為烏有。
